confirmed: Source confirms the two-second paired-target requirement and the STOP, STEADY, and RESCUE effects suggested by the first-pass packet.

changed_judgments: Execution rises to 4 for upper step launches and lower gap/dodge; recovery 3 reflects the long resettable dependency chain, while clarity remains 2 because target text was already visible.
unresolved: No human pair was observed; first-time discovery, actual coordination friction, and success distribution remain unknown.

single_operator_note: One operator must keep Isp STOP and later Pac STEADY while executing the partner route; the two-second dual hold also needs simultaneous stable input positioning.
